title: TagObservation v1
description: One raw RFID read reported by a reader adapter (owner: Dong A; consumers: Thong mobile TagReadSource, farm-edge gate ingress, Phuc verification). A raw observation is NOT a passage, a count change or a health record. Hardware model/SDK is not yet known: this contract and the emulator verify software behaviour only, not range, interference, frequency or physical timing.

observationId.description: Stable ID of this read. A reader retransmit of the same read reuses the same ID, so consumers dedupe on it.

readerId.description: Provisioned reader identity, e.g. GATE-FARM01-A or MOB-<device>.

readerKind.description: MOBILE = handheld scan paired to the phone app; GATE = fixed reader at a farm gate.

seq.description: Monotonic per readerId, starting at 1 after reader provisioning. A jump means a gap (missed reads); a repeat with the same observationId means a retransmit.

tagId.description: Raw tag value read from the ear tag (permanent RFID). Mapping to cattleId is done by the owner service, not by the reader.

observedAt.description: Reader source time (RFC 3339, with offset). May drift; consumers record their own receivedAt.

receivedAt.description: Optional: time the adapter received the read.

direction.description: GATE readers only, and only if the hardware/antenna setup can tell direction. MOBILE scans must never carry a direction.
